- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Added new directories for references and scripts to organize documentation and tooling.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Improved project structure for easier access to supporting materials and scripts.

Initial release of Concept Cartographer.

- Auto-generates prerequisite maps for any topic, visualizing dependencies and optimal learning order.
- Supports mapping, auditing, and customizing your own knowledge baseline for personalized learning paths.
- Exports maps as JSON, text trees, or Mermaid diagrams for easy visualization and integration.
- Ships with built-in knowledge graphs for programming, math, science, business, and web domains.
- Command-line interface for mapping, pathfinding, auditing, and visualization tasks.
